items.exampleEn: We discovered a small cafe near the river.
items.exampleZh: 我們在河邊發現了一家小咖啡店。
湖面映出了群山的倒影。

items.exampleEn: This old shop has existed for a hundred years.
items.exampleZh: 這家老店已經存在一百年了。

items.exampleEn: My first task today is to answer emails.
items.exampleZh: 我今天的第一項任務是回覆電子郵件。

items.exampleEn: She took a beautiful shot of the lake.
items.exampleZh: 她拍了一張很美的湖景照。

items.exampleEn: He admitted that he was wrong.
Fans are waiting for the release of her new album.
items.exampleZh: 歌迷們都在等她新專輯的發行。

items.exampleEn: The bus drivers are on strike today.

items.sentenceEn: The strike ended after three days.

items.audioEn: We discovered a small beach that nobody knew about.
items.audioZh: 我們發現了一個沒人知道的小海灘。

items.sentenceEn: I have one more task to finish.
items.sentenceZh: 我還有一項任務要完成。

items.sentenceEn: He admitted eating all the cookies.
items.sentenceZh: 他承認餅乾全是他吃掉的。

items.stemEn: The new phone's ____ date is in May.
items.stemZh: 這款新手機的發售日期在五月。

items.passageEn: Last summer, Emma traveled around Taiwan by train. One day, there was a train strike, so she had to change her plans. She took a bus to a small village and discovered a beautiful lake. The water reflected the mountains like a mirror, and she took many shots with her camera. "I must admit the strike was lucky for me," she said. She never knew such a place existed.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，Emma 搭火車在台灣各地旅行。有一天火車罷工，她只好改變計畫。她搭公車到一個小村莊，發現了一座美麗的湖。湖水像鏡子一樣映出群山，她用相機拍了好多照片。她說：「我得承認，那次罷工對我來說真是幸運。」她從來不知道有這樣的地方存在。

questions.questionZh: 那天 Emma 為什麼得改變計畫？
Emma 在小村莊發現了什麼？

items.promptZh: 這部電影的上映日期是哪一天？
referenceEn: What is the release date of this movie?
Do you know the release date of this movie?
rubricZh: 「上映日期」可寫例如 release date；寫 When does this movie come out? 等也正確
問句可寫例如 What is the release date…?、Do you know the release date…?

items.instructionZh: 用 discover 造一個句子，說說你曾經發現的一個地方或一樣東西。
referenceEn: Last week, I discovered a nice cafe near my office.
I discovered an old photo in my father's desk.
rubricZh: discover 後面接發現的東西（例如 discovered a nice cafe）
說過去的事用過去式（例如 discovered）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：雙答案：admit 有「讓…進入」之義，"The windows admit the sunlight."（窗戶讓陽光照進來）是合文法、可見於書面的正確英文；干擾項 admit 應換掉（例如換成 exist 以外的不及物或語意明顯不合的字）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 ["remember","discover","reflect","forget"]（原 ["admit","exist","reflect","discover"]）；雙答案：干擾項 admit 換成填入後語意明顯不通的同詞性動詞（remember、forget）；四選項皆為及物動詞，只能靠詞義判斷

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：選項釋義同步
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 ["記得","發現","反射","忘記"]（原 ["承認","存在","反射","發現"]）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項已替換，執行長裁示：判題更新為修正後的唯一正解（審題員原判 [2,0]）

執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：寫死單一說法：「『上映日期』用 release date」未用「例如」；且第二條「問句可用 What 或 When 開頭」是封閉清單，When will this movie come out? / When is this movie released? 等也正確。建議改「例如 release date；寫 When is this movie released? 也正確」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "「上映日期」可寫例如 release date；寫 When does this movie come out? 等也正確"（原 "「上映日期」用 release date"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關同條：問句開頭不寫封閉清單
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "問句可寫例如 What is the release date…?、Do you know the release date…?"（原 "問句可用 What 或 When 開頭（例如 What is the release date…?）"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關："When is the release date of this movie?" 語意重複（When＋date），不夠道地，建議改 "When will this movie be released?"
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Do you know the release date of this movie?"（原 "When is the release date of this movie?"）；審題員建議的 be released 是 release 的動詞用法（B1），目標字照課綱只教名詞，故改成不重複的另一問法
